system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> how you let <USER> have 2 Holiday Spotify Singles but no <USER> ?? <URL>"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! I get your frustration. While we’d love to have all artists available, some content may not be ready yet. Check out our updates here: <URL> Keep us posted!"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply is vague; clarify content availability and avoid informal tone for professionalism."}
